machine_start_gcode:
G90 ; use absolute coordinates
M83 ; extruder relative mode
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
G28 ; home all
G34 ; Z steppers auto-alignment
G29 ; probe the bed with the BLTouch
M420 S1 ; enable bed leveling compensation
G1 X0 Y0 Z10 F3000 ; park at the front left while the nozzle heats
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set extruder temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for extruder temp
G1 X0 Y1.0 Z0.3 F1000 ; move print head to the start of the prime line
G92 E0.0
; initial load
G1 X205.0 E19 F1000
G1 Y1.6
G1 X5.0 E19 F1000
G92 E0.0
; intro line
G1 Y2.0 Z0.2 F1000
G1 X65.0 E9.0 F1000
G1 X105.0 E12.5 F1000
G92 E0.0
name: CR-10 BLTouch
machine_end_gcode:
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0.0
G1{if max_layer_z < max_print_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, max_print_height)}{endif} E-34.0 F720 ; move print head up & retract filament
G4 ; wait
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X0 Y300 F3000 ; park print head at the back left
M84 ; disable motors
